parsed_output.email_body:
Dear Bones Coffee Team,

We have noticed your successful use of paid social media and search advertising to drive revenue through email and SMS campaigns. However, we believe there is an opportunity to further engage your target audience by incorporating TV advertising into your email and SMS marketing strategy. By showcasing a unique product feature in a visually appealing way, we can help Bones Coffee reach a wider audience and drive revenue through email and SMS campaigns.

We propose a collaborative Instagram post featuring a product that has a unique feature, such as a surprise element or a colorful design. This post would not only highlight the product's unique features but also engage your target audience in a visually appealing way.

Looking forward to your thoughts on this proposal.

Best regards,
[Your Team]
